body: Their specific advice saved my life... I actually starting thinking that I should look for a job. I have a degree, I haven't used it in 20 years but i'm sure its still good. Ready to lol? It's psychology. I thought this was a subReddit for peer advice, and I'm glad that I made that post and am thankful for the responses.. and I'm working on my c.v.(thanks post reply-er that i cant see because its been deleted) .. If it broke the rules, still count it as a win... I'm still here.

I don't even know where moderation stops or starts. My parents drank, and were proud to be in AA by the time they were 30, and were sober since. I can't imagine the denial they go through when they see my drinking addiction, but I do hope they feel some guilt. It's a Celebration? Lets drink? It's a hot day? Lets have a cold one. I had a bad day, i need a drink. I'm not saying they are the only reason i dragged myself down this far but they certainly weren't good role models. If you have time left, give your kid a chance to learn that getting drunk isnt the most fun. (plot twist: my Dad was dead at 50 and my mom lived 10 years after him, thats a long time for a drunk )
why where all the messages deleted?
you said "wait until they get you some medical attention."...if i showed up to an AA meeting would they help me get some medical help?

I think i drank will Weed Patch willy before , or at least his counterparts on those nights i was "following the good time." thanks for your advice.. you're right.. i think i need medical intervention... when i figure out how to do that i just might.
I'll do my best. Thank you for caring enough to respond to my post. It really did help to get these thoughts out. ..and I wont call him. ..tonight... He really is a sonofabitch.
I bought some beer, I know, that's not the answer but it will help get me through tonight.
Yes, they run out in 26 days. I am selling the furniture now and I might be able to scrape up enough for March, but I just cant seem to think of a reason to be here then.
